relationships.subject: NAI-112
relationships.evidence_quote: NAI-112 led to an increase in phosphatidic acid levels in both no-pain and pain models and to a decrease in lysophosphatidic acid levels in the pain model only.

relationships.subject: NAI-112
relationships.evidence_quote: the level of LPA (18:0, stearoyl-PA) was significantly reduced in the presence of NAI-112 in in-pain mice (panel D).

relationships.subject: lysophosphatidic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: It was demonstrated that TRPV1 is a direct molecular target of the pain-producing molecule LPA

relationships.subject: NAI-112
relationships.evidence_quote: We also showed that NAI-112 can form complexes with dipalmitoyl-phosphatidic acid

key_findings: NAI-112 raises spinal PA and lowers LPA in pain model mice, consistent with action on the TRPV1 pathway without direct TRPV1 binding.
NAI-112 forms 1:1 complexes with PA/LPA; resistant S. aureus resemble VISA strains.
